title: Topic 02: Where Do You Live?
subtitle: Kenalan di Rooftop Lounge Kantor & Bahas Tempat Tinggal

dialogue.text: Topic two: Where Do You Live? During a morning break in the office rooftop lounge, Hannah chats with Kenji, a new coworker on her floor.
dialogue.cloze: Topic two: Where Do You Live? During a morning break in the office rooftop lounge...
dialogue.cueId: Narator membacakan pembukaan adegan di rooftop lounge kantor.
dialogue.meaning: Topik 2: Di Mana Kamu Tinggal? Saat istirahat pagi di rooftop lounge kantor, Hannah mengobrol dengan Kenji, rekan kerja baru di lantainya.

dialogue.text: Excuse me—are you the new employee on the product team?
dialogue.cloze: Excuse me—are you the _____ _____ on the product team?
dialogue.cueId: Sapa karyawan baru di rooftop lounge dan pastikan dia dari tim produk!
dialogue.phonetic: Ik-skyooz me—ah yuh the nyoo im-PLOI-ee on thuh PRA-dukt teem?
dialogue.meaning: Permisi—apakah kamu karyawan baru di tim produk?

dialogue.text: Oh, yes! Good morning. I'm Kenjiro, by the way.
dialogue.cloze: Oh, yes! Good morning. _____ Kenjiro, by the way.
dialogue.cueId: Iya, selamat pagi! Kenalkan namamu sebagai Kenjiro.
dialogue.phonetic: Oh, yes! Gud MOR-ning. I'm Ken-JEE-roh, by thuh way.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, iya! Selamat pagi. Ngomong-ngomong, aku Kenjiro.

dialogue.text: Nice to meet you! I'm Hannah, but you can call me Han. Where are you from?
dialogue.cloze: Nice to meet you! I'm Hannah, but _____ _____ _____ me Han. _____ are you from?
dialogue.cueId: Kenalkan dirimu Hannah (panggil saja Han), lalu tanya asalnya!
dialogue.phonetic: Nice-tuh meetchu! I'm HAN-uh, but yuh-kn call me Han. Where-er-yuh from?
dialogue.meaning: Senang bertemu denganmu! Aku Hannah, tapi kamu bisa panggil aku Han. Kamu berasal dari mana?

dialogue.text: I'm from Japan. I just flew in last weekend. Are you American?
dialogue.cloze: _____ _____ Japan. I just flew in last weekend. Are you American?
dialogue.cueId: Jawab asalmu dari Jepang (baru terbang akhir pekan lalu) dan balik tanya dia orang Amerika?
dialogue.phonetic: I'm frum Juh-PAN. I jus floo-in last WEEK-end. Ah yuh uh-MER-i-kn?
dialogue.meaning: Aku berasal dari Jepang. Aku baru mendarat akhir pekan lalu. Kamu orang Amerika?

dialogue.text: No, I'm British! Still getting used to the weather here. Where are you staying right now?
dialogue.cloze: No, I'm British! Still getting used to the weather here. _____ are you _____ right now?
dialogue.cueId: Jelaskan kamu orang Inggris dan tanya sekarang Kenji menginap di mana!
dialogue.phonetic: No, I'm BRI-tish! Still geddin yooz-tuh thuh WE-thuh here. Where-uh yuh STAY-ing right now?
dialogue.meaning: Bukan, aku orang Inggris! Masih membiasakan diri dengan cuaca di sini. Sekarang kamu tinggal sementara di mana?

dialogue.text: I'm staying in a hotel near the train station, but I'm looking for an apartment. Where do you live?
dialogue.cloze: I'm _____ in a _____ near the train station, but I'm _____ for an apartment. _____ do you live?
dialogue.cueId: Bilang masih di hotel dekat stasiun sambil cari apartemen, lalu tanya rumah Hannah!
dialogue.phonetic: I'm STAY-ing in-uh hoh-TEL near thuh train STAY-shn, bud-aim LOO-king for-un uh-PART-munt. Where-d'yuh live?
dialogue.meaning: Aku masih menginap di hotel dekat stasiun kereta, tapi sedang mencari apartemen. Kamu tinggal di mana?

dialogue.text: I live by the park—just ten minutes away. It's a really nice, safe, and quiet neighborhood.
dialogue.cloze: I _____ by the _____—just ten minutes away. It's a really nice, safe, and _____ neighborhood.
dialogue.cueId: Ceritakan kamu tinggal di dekat taman—cuma 10 menit, lingkungannya aman dan tenang.
dialogue.phonetic: I live by thuh park—jus ten MI-nits uh-way. It's-uh ree-lee nice, safe, un KWAI-ut NAY-buh-hud.
dialogue.meaning: Aku tinggal di dekat taman—cuma sepuluh menit dari sini. Lingkungannya bagus, aman, dan tenang banget.

dialogue.text: Sounds amazing. My hotel room faces the main street, so it's pretty noisy at night.
dialogue.cloze: Sounds amazing. My hotel room faces the main street, so it's pretty _____ at night.
dialogue.cueId: Puji lingkungannya, lalu keluhkan kamar hotelmu menghadap jalan utama jadi agak berisik malam hari.
dialogue.phonetic: Soundz uh-MAY-zing. My hoh-TEL room FAY-siz thuh main street, so it's pri-dee NOI-zee ut night.
dialogue.meaning: Kedengarannya seru banget. Kamar hotelku menghadap jalan utama, jadi cukup berisik pas malam hari.

dialogue.text: Ugh, I can't stand traffic noise either. Honestly, I prefer quiet places.
dialogue.cloze: Ugh, I can't stand traffic noise either. Honestly, I _____ _____ _____.
dialogue.cueId: Ungkapkan kamu juga nggak tahan suara macet dan lebih suka tempat yang tenang!
dialogue.phonetic: Ugh, I kahnt stand TRA-fik noiz EE-thuh. ON-ist-lee, I pri-FUH KWAI-ut PLAY-siz.
dialogue.meaning: Duh, aku juga nggak tahan kebisingan lalu lintas. Jujur, aku lebih suka tempat yang tenang.

dialogue.text: Same here! Do you know if there are any apartments available by the park?
dialogue.cloze: _____ _____! Do you know if there are any apartments available by the park?
dialogue.cueId: Setujui dengan santai ('Same here!'), lalu tanya info apartemen kosong di dekat taman.
dialogue.phonetic: Same here! D'yuh know if ther-ar EN-ee uh-PART-munts uh-VAY-luh-bl by thuh park?
dialogue.meaning: Sama banget! Kamu tahu nggak apakah ada apartemen kosong di dekat taman?

dialogue.text: Actually, my next-door neighbor just moved out! Let me check with my landlord. Do you have a business card?
dialogue.cloze: Actually, my next-door neighbor just moved out! Let me check with my landlord. Do you have a _____ _____?
dialogue.cueId: Kasih kabar tetangga sebelah baru pindah! Tawarkan cek ke pemilik gedung dan tanya kartu namanya.
dialogue.phonetic: AK-choo-lee, my nekst-dor NAY-buh jus moovd-out! Lemme check with my LAND-lord. D'yuh hav-uh BIZ-nus kard?
dialogue.meaning: Kebetulan tetangga sebelahku baru saja pindah! Biar kutanyakan ke pemilik properti. Kamu punya kartu nama?

dialogue.text: Haha, not yet! You can just contact me via Instagram at @kenji.sato, or message me on WhatsApp at 415-820-3946.
dialogue.cloze: Haha, not yet! You can just _____ _____ _____ Instagram at @kenji.sato, or message me on WhatsApp at 415-820-3946.
dialogue.cueId: Belum punya kartu nama! Kasih Instagram @kenji.sato dan nomor WhatsApp 415-820-3946.
dialogue.phonetic: (chuckle) Not yet! Yuh-kn jus KON-takt me vee-uh IN-stuh-gram at kenji-dot-sato, or ME-sij me on WOTS-ap at four-one-five, eight-two-oh, three-nine-four-six.
dialogue.meaning: Haha, belum punya nih! Kamu bisa hubungi aku lewat Instagram @kenji.sato, atau chat WhatsApp di 415-820-3946.

dialogue.text: Way easier than a card! I'll add you on WhatsApp right now. Just promise me one thing—no loud midnight parties!
dialogue.cloze: Way easier than a card! I'll add you on WhatsApp right now. Just promise me one thing—no loud midnight parties!
dialogue.cueId: Tambahkan WhatsApp Kenji sekarang sambil bercanda: asal janji nggak bikin pesta tengah malam yang berisik!
dialogue.phonetic: Way EE-zee-uh thun uh kard! I'll ad-yoo on WOTS-ap right now. Jus PRA-mis me one thing—no loud MID-night PAR-teez!
dialogue.meaning: Jauh lebih praktis dari kartu nama! Aku add WhatsApp kamu sekarang ya. Cuma janji satu hal—jangan ada pesta tengah malam yang berisik!

dialogue.text: Haha, you have my word! I'm usually asleep by ten anyway.
dialogue.cloze: Haha, you have my word! I'm usually asleep by ten anyway.
dialogue.cueId: Yakinkan dengan santai: kamu pegang janjiku, aku biasanya sudah tidur jam 10 kok!
dialogue.phonetic: (chuckle) Yoo hav my wurd! I'm YOO-zhoo-lee uh-SLEEP by ten E-nee-way.
dialogue.meaning: Haha, pegang janjiku! Lagian aku biasanya sudah tidur jam sepuluh kok.

dialogue.cueId: Tutup obrolan dengan ramah sebelum kembali ke meja kerja.
dialogue.meaning: Mantap. Sampai ketemu lagi nanti, Ken!

rapidResponse.question: Who is the new employee on the product team?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: Kenjiro, or Kenji, is the new employee on the product team.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Are you a student, freelancer, or employee right now?

rapidResponse.question: Where do Hannah and Kenji chat during the morning break?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: They chat in the office rooftop lounge.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Do you have a favorite spot to take a break at school or work?

rapidResponse.question: What nickname can Kenji call Hannah?
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Do you have a nickname? What do friends call you?

rapidResponse.question: Where is Kenji from?
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Which city or province are you from originally?

rapidResponse.question: Is Hannah American or British?
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Which English accent do you prefer listening to—British or American?

rapidResponse.question: Where is Kenji staying right now?
rapidResponse.shortAnswer: In a hotel near the train station.
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: He is staying in a hotel near the train station.
rapidResponse.hint: In a _____ near the train station.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Have you ever stayed in a hotel near a station or airport?

rapidResponse.question: What kind of home is Kenji looking for?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: He is looking for an apartment, preferably by the park.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Do you prefer living in a house, kos, or an apartment?

rapidResponse.question: Where does Hannah live?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: Hannah lives by the park, just ten minutes away.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: What landmark is close to where you live?

rapidResponse.question: What are three adjectives Hannah uses for her neighborhood?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: She says it's a really nice, safe, and quiet neighborhood.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Is your neighborhood quiet or busy?

rapidResponse.question: Why is Kenji's hotel room noisy at night?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: His hotel room faces the main street, so there is traffic noise.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Do you prefer lively city areas or quiet places?

rapidResponse.question: Does Kenji have a business card yet?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: No, he doesn't have a business card yet.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: Do people around you still swap business cards or mostly social media?

rapidResponse.question: How can Hannah contact Kenji?
rapidResponse.fullAnswer: She can contact him via Instagram at @kenji.sato or WhatsApp at 415-820-3946.
rapidResponse.personalQuestion: How do new friends usually contact you—Instagram or WhatsApp?
